cases.name: the DONE report of the appended contract, filled in, passes the shape check
cases.cmd: p=$(printf '%s' '{"tool_name":"Agent","session_id":"{{SID}}","tool_input":{"subagent_type":"general-purpose","description":"d","prompt":"p","model":"sonnet"}}' | bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/delegation-guard.sh | jq -r '.hookSpecificOutput.updatedInput.prompt'); msg=$(printf '%s\n' "$p" | sed -n '/^## DONE$/,/^## BLOCKED$/p' | sed '$d' | sed 's/exit N/exit 0/'); out=$(jq -n --arg m "$msg" '{last_assistant_message: $m}' | bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/subagent-report-shape.sh); printf 'lines=%s blocked=%s' "$(printf '%s\n' "$msg" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" "${out:+yes}"

cases.name: the BLOCKED report of the appended contract passes the shape check
cases.cmd: p=$(printf '%s' '{"tool_name":"Agent","session_id":"{{SID}}","tool_input":{"subagent_type":"general-purpose","description":"d","prompt":"p","model":"sonnet"}}' | bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/delegation-guard.sh | jq -r '.hookSpecificOutput.updatedInput.prompt'); msg=$(printf '%s\n' "$p" | sed -n '/^## BLOCKED$/,/^Never work around/p' | sed '$d'); out=$(jq -n --arg m "$msg" '{last_assistant_message: $m}' | bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/subagent-report-shape.sh); printf 'lines=%s blocked=%s' "$(printf '%s\n' "$msg" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" "${out:+yes}"

cases.name: the contract without its Command line is sent back — the two hooks agree on the fields
cases.cmd: p=$(printf '%s' '{"tool_name":"Agent","session_id":"{{SID}}","tool_input":{"subagent_type":"general-purpose","description":"d","prompt":"p","model":"sonnet"}}' | bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/delegation-guard.sh | jq -r '.hookSpecificOutput.updatedInput.prompt'); msg=$(printf '%s\n' "$p" | sed -n '/^## DONE$/,/^## BLOCKED$/p' | sed '$d' | grep -v '^- Command:'); jq -n --arg m "$msg" '{last_assistant_message: $m}' | bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/subagent-report-shape.sh

cases.name: the DONE block of every agent charter passes the shape check
cases.cmd: n=0; for a in team-test-author team-implementer team-reviewer dataset-synthesizer run-analyst judge; do f={{CLAUDE}}/agents/$a.md; msg=$(awk '/^```/{f=!f; d=0; next} f && /^## DONE$/{d=1} f && d{print}' "$f" | sed 's/exit N/exit 0/'); [ -n "$msg" ] || { printf 'bad:no-block:%s ' "$a"; continue; }; out=$(jq -n --arg m "$msg" '{last_assistant_message: $m}' | bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/subagent-report-shape.sh); [ -z "$out" ] || printf 'bad:blocked:%s ' "$a"; n=$((n+1)); done; printf 'checked=%s' "$n"

cases.name: the BLOCKED block of every agent charter passes the shape check
cases.cmd: n=0; for a in team-test-author team-implementer team-reviewer dataset-synthesizer run-analyst judge; do f={{CLAUDE}}/agents/$a.md; msg=$(awk '/^```/{f=!f; d=0; next} f && /^## BLOCKED$/{d=1} f && d{print}' "$f" | sed 's/exit N/exit 0/'); [ -n "$msg" ] || { printf 'bad:no-block:%s ' "$a"; continue; }; out=$(jq -n --arg m "$msg" '{last_assistant_message: $m}' | bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/subagent-report-shape.sh); [ -z "$out" ] || printf 'bad:blocked:%s ' "$a"; n=$((n+1)); done; printf 'checked=%s' "$n"

cases.name: templates/STATUS.md is read by guard-phase as phase need
cases.cmd: t={{FIX}}/teams/tpl-{{SID}}; w={{FIX}}/workbooks/tpl-{{SID}}; mkdir -p "$w" && cp {{CLAUDE}}/templates/STATUS.md "$w/STATUS.md" && jq -n --arg p "$t/crew/config.yaml" '{tool_name: "Write", tool_input: {file_path: $p, content: "x"}}' | bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/guard-phase.sh

cases.name: the reminder of status-check names exactly the front-matter keys of templates/STATUS.md
cases.cmd: keys=$(awk 'NR==1{next} /^---/{exit} {sub(/:.*/, ""); print}' {{CLAUDE}}/templates/STATUS.md | paste -sd, - | sed 's/,/, /g'); if grep -qF "$keys" {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/status-check.sh; then printf 'ok %s' "$keys"; else printf 'MISMATCH %s' "$keys"; fi

expect.stdout: ok phase, gate_passed, track, iteration, attempt, batch, verdict, next_action, updated_at

cases.name: templates/ATTEMPT-manifest.json is an open attempt for run-gate
cases.cmd: t={{FIX}}/teams/att-{{SID}}; w={{FIX}}/workbooks/att-{{SID}}; mkdir -p "$t" "$w/attempts/ATT-0001" && cp {{CLAUDE}}/templates/ATTEMPT-manifest.json "$w/attempts/ATT-0001/manifest.json" && jq -n --arg c "$t" '{tool_name: "Bash", session_id: "{{SID}}", cwd: $c, tool_input: {command: "./run.sh --profile claude"}}' | bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/run-gate.sh

cases.name: templates/ATTEMPT-manifest.json is an open attempt for guard-phase: the main thread writes ANALYSIS.md in it
cases.cmd: t={{FIX}}/teams/att-{{SID}}; w={{FIX}}/workbooks/att-{{SID}}; mkdir -p "$w/attempts/ATT-0001" && cp {{CLAUDE}}/templates/ATTEMPT-manifest.json "$w/attempts/ATT-0001/manifest.json" && out=$(jq -n --arg p "$w/attempts/ATT-0001/ANALYSIS.md" '{tool_name: "Write", tool_input: {file_path: $p, content: "x"}}' | bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/guard-phase.sh); printf 'out=[%s]' "$out"

cases.name: the same manifest once closed makes the attempt read-only
cases.cmd: t={{FIX}}/teams/att-{{SID}}; w={{FIX}}/workbooks/att-{{SID}}; mkdir -p "$w/attempts/ATT-0001" && jq '.closed_at = "2026-09-30T20:00:00Z"' {{CLAUDE}}/templates/ATTEMPT-manifest.json > "$w/attempts/ATT-0001/manifest.json" && jq -n --arg p "$w/attempts/ATT-0001/ANALYSIS.md" '{tool_name: "Write", tool_input: {file_path: $p, content: "x"}}' | bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/guard-phase.sh

cases.name: the review skeleton of the team-reviewer charter passes the shape check
cases.cmd: msg=$(awk '/^```/{f=!f; if (f) {buf=""; keep=0} else if (keep) {printf "%s", buf; exit} next} f{buf = buf $0 "\n"; if ($0 ~ /^## Verdict /) keep=1}' {{CLAUDE}}/agents/team-reviewer.md | sed -e 's/<ACCEPTED|ITERATE|BLOCKED>/ITERATE/' -e 's/exit N/exit 0/'); n=$(printf '%s\n' "$msg" | grep -c '^## '); out=$(jq -n --arg m "$msg" '{agent_type: "team-reviewer", last_assistant_message: $m}' | bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/subagent-report-shape.sh); printf 'headings=%s blocked=%s' "$n" "${out:+yes}"

cases.name: a review assembled from templates/ANALYSIS.md and templates/FIX-PLAN.md passes the shape check
cases.cmd:
msg=$( { sed -e '1d' -e 's/{{VERDICT}}/ITERATE/' {{CLAUDE}}/templates/ANALYSIS.md; sed -e '1d' {{CLAUDE}}/templates/FIX-PLAN.md; printf '
## DONE
- Files: none
- Ids covered: AC-01
- Command: none
- Notes: Verdict — ITERATE (1 gap: 0 Blocking, 1 Major, 0 Minor)
'; } ); out=$(jq -n --arg m "$msg" '{agent_type: "team-reviewer", last_assistant_message: $m}' | bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/subagent-report-shape.sh); printf 'gaps=%s fixes=%s blocked=%s' "$(printf '%s
' "$msg" | grep -c '^| # | Severity | Id | Observed | Category | Evidence |$')" "$(printf '%s
' "$msg" | grep -c '^| Fix | Gap # | Change | Files | Batch | Expected effect |$')" "${out:+yes}"

cases.name: the same review without the fix table of the template is sent back
cases.cmd:
msg=$( { sed -e '1d' -e 's/{{VERDICT}}/ITERATE/' {{CLAUDE}}/templates/ANALYSIS.md; printf '
## DONE
- Files: none
- Ids covered: AC-01
- Command: none
- Notes: Verdict — ITERATE
'; } ); jq -n --arg m "$msg" '{agent_type: "team-reviewer", last_assistant_message: $m}' | bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/subagent-report-shape.sh

cases.name: templates/bench.config.json: its named profile is seen as remote by run-gate
cases.cmd: t={{FIX}}/teams/cfg-{{SID}}; c={{FIX}}/tests/cfg-{{SID}}; mkdir -p "$t" "$c" && cp {{CLAUDE}}/templates/bench.config.json "$c/bench.config.json" && jq -n --arg c "$t" '{tool_name: "Bash", session_id: "{{SID}}", cwd: $c, tool_input: {command: "./run.sh --profile claude"}}' | bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/run-gate.sh

cases.name: templates/bench.config.json: the machine profile stays allowed
cases.cmd: t={{FIX}}/teams/cfg-{{SID}}; c={{FIX}}/tests/cfg-{{SID}}; mkdir -p "$t" "$c" && cp {{CLAUDE}}/templates/bench.config.json "$c/bench.config.json" && jq -n --arg c "$t" '{tool_name: "Bash", session_id: "{{SID}}", cwd: $c, tool_input: {command: "./run.sh --profile machine"}}' | bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/run-gate.sh; cut -f3,4 "$HARNESS_RUN_LOG" | tail -1

cases.name: every state file a hook leaves in /tmp has its prefix in session-cleanup
cases.cmd: pref=$(sed -n 's/^PREFIXES="\(.*\)"$/\1/p' {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/session-cleanup.sh); n=0; for p in $(grep -ohE '/tmp/claude-[a-z]+(-[a-z]+)*-[${]' {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/*.sh {{CLAUDE}}/lib/*.sh | sed -E 's#^/tmp/claude-##; s#-[${]$##' | sort -u); do n=$((n+1)); case " $pref " in *" $p "*) ;; *) printf 'bad:%s ' "$p" ;; esac; done; printf 'prefixes=%s' "$n"

cases.name: every agent type the role matrix of guard-phase names has a charter
cases.cmd: n=0; for a in $(grep -oE '^  [a-z|-]+\)$' {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/guard-phase.sh | tr -d ' )' | tr '|' ' '); do case "$a" in team-*|dataset-*|run-*|judge) n=$((n+1)); [ -f {{CLAUDE}}/agents/$a.md ] || printf 'bad:%s ' "$a" ;; esac; done; printf 'roles=%s' "$n"
